chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi', from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl al-Nawfaly, raising it, he said:
Surah Al-Hamd is not recited upon a pain seventy times, except that it settles.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of reciting Surah Al-Fatihah for healing illness?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith to highlight the spiritual efficacy of Surah Al-Fatihah as a form of ruqyah (healing supplication). The specific mention of seventy recitations reflects the scholarly tradition of using numerically significant repetitions to intensify devotion and focus during therapeutic recitation. This practice underscores the Quran's dual role as both divine guidance and a means of physical and spiritual remedy in Shia tradition.
